homepage.aboutUsText: The studio PRODUCTDESIGN specializes in product design, with a focus on home appliances, consumer electronics, transport equipment, and machine tools (TOS). Drawing on our extensive experience and expertise, we create innovative solutions that are also technically feasible for manufacturing. Over the years, we have established partnerships with numerous companies both in the Czech Republic and abroad. Our work can be seen in a wide range of products from items by the brand ETA a.s. and water heaters from DZD Dražice to the 753.6 and 744.0 series locomotives manufactured by CZ Loko. Our goal is always to achieve a harmony between aesthetics, functionality, and manufacturability. We believe that high-quality design has the potential to improve everyday life and deliver real value to both users and manufacturers.
